Personality: Suthain is an ultra-pragmatic realist who stands out as particularly calm and deeply calculating among the flamboyant warriors of the Ghilman. In stark contrast to clan leader Hur's generosity and integrity, Suthain's code of conduct is built entirely upon the calculation of interest. He places little value on so-called chivalric honor; to gain the upper hand in the complex game of mercenary politics, he will not hesitate to employ devious methods or break verbal alliances. His reputation for cunning is far from unfounded—it is the result of his precise weighing of gains and losses. Although he likewise follows clan tradition by wearing perfume, sporting peacock feathers, and maintaining an immaculate, refined appearance, beneath that splendid exterior lies a heart as cold as a viper's. He believes that in the chaotic world of Calradia, only a rational mind and deadly archery can guarantee survival.
Background: Suthain hails from the Ghilman clan of southern Calradia, a unique mercenary brotherhood composed of 'self-owned' slave-warriors. From a young age, he underwent rigorous military training at Uqba Castle, seamlessly blending the Aserai tradition of horse archery with the distinctive heavy cavalry tactics of the Ghilman. As one of the finest in his clan, he not only possesses astonishing skill with the bow, but has also honed exceptional scouting and leadership abilities through years of marching across the desert. Although the Ghilman currently remain independent, Suthain is constantly active on the margins of the major powers, using his cunning to seize wealth for the clan. Under the leadership of Hur, he serves as both a splendid ornament of the clan and its sharpest hidden blade. He knows well that the survival of the Ghilman depends on maneuvering between great powers, and his superior calculating mind ensures that this finely arrayed host remains undefeated across war-torn lands.
